$comment: Architecture rules for this repository, checked by `npm run assert`. A rule that finds no violation over a scan with unread files is UNPROVEN, not passing.

rules.$why: A cycle between architecture components means no reader can tell which is the source of truth. Scoped to architecture documents: a sequence diagram records a reply as a second edge, which is a round trip, not a dependency cycle.
An external system with many outbound edges is usually a modelling mistake: the arrows belong to something inside the boundary.

$acknowledgedGapsNote: Each entry is a gap a human has read and judged unable to hide a violation. It names one path, must quote part of the gap reason so it stops applying if that file fails for a different cause, and carries its own reason. A rule that passes on one says so.

acknowledgedGaps.because: Dynamic import of a literal module path whose base is a local variable (await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "literal.mjs")).href)). The target is a fixed file inside this repository, not user input, so it cannot introduce an architecture dependency the scanner has not already recorded statically elsewhere.
